Mission.headline: Mesej i no jenis. Fasin we ol man oli lukluk i jenis.
Mission.intro: Mifala i stap bildim bakegen laebri blong vidio mo ol tul blong mifala stat long stat, mo mifala i karem plante yia blong wok blong transleisen i go long ol platfom we ol man oli stap hivap, lukluk, mo sharem finis.
Mission.libraryPointTitle: Film laebri we i gat moa transleisen long wol
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Plante yia blong wok blong transleisen, we ol misin patna we yumi trastem oli karem, i bildim wan laebri wetem plante taosen lanwis trek, blong ol man oli kasem stori blong Jisas long lanwis we i tajem hat blong olgeta moa.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Karem ol voes we yumi trastem i go long ol niufala fasin
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Mifala i stap bildim bakegen fasin blong talem ol stori blong Gud Nius long pija. Mifala i joenem ol transleisen we yumi trastem wetem ol niufala fom, blong mesej i save muv fri long ol platfom, kalja, mo skrin.
Mission.teamPointTitle: I bitim wan laebri. Wan tim we i wok from misin.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project i wan tim long wol blong ol transleita, ol spesalis blong media, ol edita, mo ol man blong krietem samting, we oli tanem plante yia blong eksperiens long misin i kam ol tul blong ol man we oli mekem disaepol long evri ples.
Mission.highlightsHeading: Wanem we mifala i bildim nekis
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Konektem ol man we oli lukluk wetem ol rili janis long wokbaot blong olgeta wetem God, blong helpem olgeta tekem nekis step i go long komuniti, Tok blong God, o misin.
Mission.mediaLibraryTitle: Media Laebri blong Talemaot Gud Nius
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Wan bigfala laebri blong Kristin media wetem plante taosen vidio, film, mo risos long plante lanwis, blong misin mo blong talemaot Gud Nius long olgeta ples long wol.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Fasin blong lukaot long vidio, blong seraotem kontent, blong joen wetem ol man we oli lukluk, mo blong stadi long namba, we oli mekem blong helpem ol misin oli kasem moa man gud.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Helpem blong bildim {accent} blong ol tul blong misin
Mission.inviteBody: Mifala i singaotem ol wokman, ol man blong krietem samting, mo ol patna blong traem fastaem. Testem ol niufala tul fastaem, talem tingting blong yu, mo helpem blong mekem ol samting we oli mekem blong rili wok blong misin.
Mission.missionCardAriaHint: I openem pej blong misin blong Jesus Film
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: I openem pej blong misin blong Jesus Film long seksen blong plan blong fiuja
Mission.betaCardAriaHint: I openem saenap blong beta long braoser blong yu
